dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing of the body mass from the mid-section toward the visible posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Margins appear smooth and symmetrical with no visible localized bulges or indentations along the lateral edges.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median pixel intensity indicates a uniform slate grey skin tone across the visible dorsal area.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A small, light-colored 'V' shaped or chevron mark is visible posterior to the blowhole on the dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, light-toned chevron mark is situated on the dorsal surface posterior to the blowhole region.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced specular highlights (water-glare) across the lateral-left dorsal surface; blowhole is clearly defined and open.
